subject.title: fix(channels): keep healthy accounts running when credential files fail

question: Should OpenClaw publish the shared credential-file status/diagnostic result as a plugin SDK contract and adopt account-scoped partial startup instead of the prior all-or-nothing failure behavior?
rationale: The patch changes a cross-plugin public contract and an operator-visible startup policy; code review cannot safely choose the permanent compatibility boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the scoped contract
options.body: Keep the shared typed result after removing the release-owned changelog edit and adding redacted real Gateway proof of degraded-account isolation.

options.title: Contain the change
options.body: Keep the bug fix but redesign it behind an existing generic channel contract so a new plugin-SDK secret-file API is not published.

options.title: Retain hard failure
options.body: Reject partial startup if operators must continue receiving a process-level failure for unavailable explicit credential files.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped contract
recommendation.body: Keep the shared typed result after removing the release-owned changelog edit and adding redacted real Gateway proof of degraded-account isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the proposed cross-channel implementation and linked problem report, making them the best available routing candidate for the API and startup-policy decision.
